title: POWERPLAY: Training an Increasingly General Problem Solver by Continually Searching for the Simplest Still Unsolvable Problem
problem: Expand a solver's repertoire without forgetting previously acquired skills.
assumption_broken: The tasks used to train a solver need not be externally specified and can instead be invented jointly with solver modifications.
operational_signature: Invent → modify → verify novelty and preservation → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Accept a task-solver pair only after demonstrating that the new solver solves a previously unsolved task while preserving earlier solutions.

title: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Enable autonomous goal-directed learning in underspecified circumstances after deployment.
assumption_broken: A deployed system's reasoning behavior can continue improving within designer-imposed boundaries rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Observe → model → prioritize → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Value-driven dynamic priority scheduling coordinates parallel reasoning threads using accumulating models of the system and environment.

title: Self-Modification of Policy and Utility Function in Rational Agents
problem: Prevent self-modifying agents from undermining their original goals by changing their policy or utility function.
assumption_broken: Goal preservation is not automatic for rational agents and depends on the value function used to judge self-modification.
operational_signature: Consider modifications → predict consequences → evaluate under current goals → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Evaluate future self-modifications with the current utility function while anticipating their effects on future policies.

title: A Formulation of Recursive Self-Improvement and Its Possible Efficiency
problem: Formalize whether recursively replacing program generators can efficiently reach a target program.
assumption_broken: Improvement can be measured by the ability to generate better future programs rather than immediate task performance.
operational_signature: Generate → score future reachability → compare → replace generator
load_bearing_mechanism: A consistent score orders generators by their expected steps to reach the target and permits only improving transitions.

title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET): Endlessly Generating Increasingly Complex and Diverse Learning Environments and Their Solutions
problem: Discover challenging tasks and effective solutions that direct optimization or a single curriculum cannot reach.
assumption_broken: Training environments and their curricula can evolve alongside solutions rather than being fixed by researchers.
operational_signature: Mutate challenges → filter for learnability and novelty → optimize solutions → transfer stepping stones
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-environment transfer of agents preserves useful stepping stones that unlock otherwise inaccessible solutions.

title: AutoML-Zero: Evolving Machine Learning Algorithms From Scratch
problem: Discover complete learning algorithms without restricting search to sophisticated human-designed components.
assumption_broken: The initialization, prediction, and learning rule can all be searched from elementary mathematical instructions.
operational_signature: Mutate programs → execute learning tasks → rank candidates → propagate winners
load_bearing_mechanism: Regularized evolutionary search accumulates executable algorithmic stepping stones in a sparse space of elementary operations.

title: Performance of Bounded-Rational Agents With the Ability to Self-Modify
problem: Determine whether self-modification safety survives bounded rationality and imperfect knowledge.
assumption_broken: Near-optimal decision making need not preserve the goal-stability guarantees of perfect rationality.
operational_signature: Bound errors → model self-modification → propagate value loss → compare guarantees
load_bearing_mechanism: Worst-case value-loss bounds distinguish exponentially compounding optimization errors from noncompounding knowledge errors.

title: Emergent Complexity and Zero-shot Transfer via Unsupervised Environment Design
problem: Generate structured, challenging but solvable training environments that prepare policies for novel conditions.
assumption_broken: An adversary should maximize regret rather than simply minimize the learner's reward.
operational_signature: Generate challenges → compare paired returns → update generator → train learner
load_bearing_mechanism: An antagonist supplies a solvability reference so the environment adversary rewards tasks the protagonist fails but another agent can solve.

title: GrIPS: Gradient-free, Edit-based Instruction Search for Prompting Large Language Models
problem: Improve discrete task instructions for black-box language models without gradients or manual rewriting.
assumption_broken: Instructions that are semantically coherent to humans are not necessarily the best-performing prompts.
operational_signature: Edit phrases → score predictions → accept improvement → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Greedy phrase-level edits are selected using balanced accuracy and prediction entropy on a small score set.

title: GPS: Genetic Prompt Search for Efficient Few-shot Learning
problem: Replace manual prompt engineering with automatic few-shot hard-prompt search without model updates.
assumption_broken: Fluent prompt variants generated automatically can outperform handcrafted templates without tuning model parameters.
operational_signature: Generate variants → score on examples → retain top prompts → reproduce
load_bearing_mechanism: Repeated generative prompt mutation and top-k selection progressively enrich a pool of effective templates.

title: Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers
problem: Automatically find instructions that reliably steer black-box language models toward desired outputs.
assumption_broken: Language models can generate and select their own effective task instructions instead of relying on human prompt engineers.
operational_signature: Infer instructions → execute candidates → filter by score → select instruction
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-generated instruction proposals are filtered by task execution scores, allocating more evaluation to promising candidates.

title: TEMPERA: Test-Time Prompting via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Produce query-dependent discrete prompts efficiently without expensive per-query black-box search.
assumption_broken: A single task-wide prompt need not be shared by all queries; a learned editor can adapt it at inference time.
operational_signature: Encode query and prompt → choose edits → construct tailored prompt → predict
load_bearing_mechanism: A reinforcement-learned editing policy uses consecutive score differences to learn query-conditioned changes to instructions, examples, and verbalizers.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
problem: Enable language agents to learn from failed attempts without expensive weight updates.
assumption_broken: Reinforcement can modify persistent linguistic memory rather than model weights.
operational_signature: Attempt → evaluate → reflect → store lessons → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Task feedback is converted into actionable self-reflections retained as context for subsequent trials.

title: WizardLM: Empowering large pre-trained language models to follow complex instructions
problem: Produce diverse high-complexity instruction-tuning data without expensive human annotation.
assumption_broken: Training instruction complexity and diversity can be increased automatically by evolving existing instructions.
operational_signature: Rewrite tasks → generate responses → eliminate failures → accumulate → fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled in-depth and in-breadth instruction evolution supplies harder and more diverse training examples.

title: SCM: Enhancing Large Language Model with Self-Controlled Memory Framework
problem: Preserve and retrieve relevant historical information beyond a language model's context limit.
assumption_broken: Long-context capability can be supplied by controlled external memory without modifying or fine-tuning the language model.
operational_signature: Observe → retrieve selectively → reorganize memories → respond → store
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory controller decides whether retrieval is needed and whether summaries suffice, limiting distracting history.

title: Automatic Prompt Optimization with "Gradient Descent" and Beam Search
problem: Direct black-box prompt optimization toward observed errors while reducing expensive candidate evaluations.
assumption_broken: Natural-language critiques can provide a useful optimization direction without differentiating model parameters.
operational_signature: Collect errors → verbalize flaws → rewrite against critiques → bandit-select candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Error-conditioned textual gradients guide beam expansion while best-arm identification concentrates evaluation budget on promising prompts.

title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
problem: Maintain personalized continuity and accurate recall over extended chatbot interactions.
assumption_broken: An LLM's persistent understanding of users can evolve through external memory rather than repeated model training.
operational_signature: Record interactions → summarize events and traits → retrieve context → reinforce or forget
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical conversational memories and evolving user portraits are retrieved to condition personalized responses.

title: CREATOR: Tool Creation for Disentangling Abstract and Concrete Reasoning of Large Language Models
problem: Overcome limited tool availability and fragile reasoning when solving new problems with language models.
assumption_broken: Language models can create reusable tools rather than merely select from a fixed set of APIs.
operational_signature: Abstract reusable procedure → decide invocation → execute → rectify errors
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating abstract tool creation from concrete invocation reduces reasoning burden and enables execution-guided correction.

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
problem: Accumulate reusable embodied capabilities during open-ended exploration without fine-tuning model weights.
assumption_broken: An embodied language agent can grow through a library of executable skills and a self-generated curriculum rather than a fixed action repertoire.
operational_signature: Propose task → retrieve skills → generate and repair code → verify → store reusable skill
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful action programs are retained and composed through a skill library, enabling cumulative learning and transfer.

title: Large Language Models as Tool Makers
problem: Reduce the cost of repeatedly solving complex tasks while retaining the performance of a powerful model.
assumption_broken: Expensive reasoning can be amortized into reusable tools that a cheaper language model invokes.
operational_signature: Generate tool → verify and wrap → cache functionality → dispatch and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A strong tool maker converts task demonstrations into reusable Python functions consumed by a lightweight tool user.

title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
problem: Improve the usefulness of agent reflections beyond what a frozen language model can generate.
assumption_broken: The reflection component, rather than the black-box actor, can be trained directly from downstream task rewards.
operational_signature: Attempt → diagnose failure → retry with reflection → measure reward change → train reflector
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-gradient training rewards reflections according to the improvement in the actor's next episode return.

title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
problem: Transfer lessons from agent experience across tasks without parameter updates or repeated evaluation-time retries.
assumption_broken: An agent can learn across tasks by retaining general insights and successful trajectories outside its weights.
operational_signature: Collect successes and failures → extract and revise insights → retrieve examples → solve unseen tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting failed and successful trajectories yields reusable insights that complement retrieval of successful demonstrations.

title: Confucius: Iterative Tool Learning from Introspection Feedback by Easy-to-Difficult Curriculum
problem: Teach models to select and compose complicated tools from large, noisy candidate sets.
assumption_broken: A static self-instruct dataset is insufficient because tool difficulty depends on the learner's current weaknesses.
operational_signature: Train progressively → identify difficult instances → synthesize targeted examples → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: High-perplexity tool-use instances guide iterative dataset expansion toward tools the current model has not mastered.

title: Large Language Models as Optimizers
problem: Optimize discrete prompts and other black-box objectives without task-specific update algorithms or gradients.
assumption_broken: An LLM can infer useful search directions from a natural-language problem description and scored solution history.
operational_signature: Present scored history → propose candidates → evaluate objective → retain high scorers → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A score-sorted trajectory of successful past candidates conditions the LLM to propose progressively stronger solutions.

title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers
problem: Automatically discover effective discrete prompts without gradient access or extensive manual prompt engineering.
assumption_broken: Evolutionary operators need not edit independent tokens because an LLM can implement coherent mutation and crossover in natural language.
operational_signature: Initialize candidates → recombine and mutate → score candidates → retain fitter candidates → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-executed genetic or differential-evolution operators combine coherent prompt generation with fitness-guided population search.

title: Promptbreeder: Self-Referential Self-Improvement Via Prompt Evolution
problem: Hand-crafted prompting strategies and iterative prompt search can plateau before discovering effective domain-specific reasoning instructions.
assumption_broken: The mutation instructions governing prompt search can evolve alongside the task prompts rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Initialize paired candidates → evaluate fitness → select winners → mutate candidates and mutation rules → replace losers
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolution jointly retains task prompts and their mutation prompts, allowing the prompt generator itself to improve through hyper-mutation.

title: CRAFT: Customizing LLMs by Creating and Retrieving from Specialized Toolsets
problem: General-purpose tool APIs do not provide the specialized reusable operations needed for particular downstream problems.
assumption_broken: Task-specific tool libraries can be synthesized and validated from training examples rather than manually supplied.
operational_signature: Sample diverse problems → generate solutions → abstract and validate → deduplicate and store → retrieve and compose
load_bearing_mechanism: Verified abstraction converts individual code solutions into reusable tools that multi-view retrieval selects for new problems.

title: Self-Taught Optimizer (STOP): Recursively Self-Improving Code Generation
problem: Manually written language-model scaffolds restrict the quality of generated programs and require human optimizer design.
assumption_broken: A program-improvement scaffold can be submitted to its own improvement procedure rather than remaining fixed.
operational_signature: Propose program edits → evaluate utility → retain best program → apply improver to itself → reuse improved improver
load_bearing_mechanism: The same LM-infused program optimizer rewrites its own scaffolding to discover stronger program-search strategies.

title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
problem: Hard-coded prompt strings make multi-stage language-model pipelines brittle and expensive to adapt to models and tasks.
assumption_broken: Module demonstrations and prompting parameters can be compiled against an end-to-end metric instead of manually authored for every pipeline stage.
operational_signature: Declare modules → execute candidate pipelines → collect successful traces → assign demonstrations → evaluate compiled pipeline
load_bearing_mechanism: Metric-guided bootstrapping turns successful intermediate execution traces into module-specific demonstrations without requiring intermediate labels.

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
problem: Fixed context windows prevent language-model agents from retaining long conversations and reasoning across large documents.
assumption_broken: Relevant context need not remain permanently in the prompt because the model can manage an external memory hierarchy itself.
operational_signature: Observe events → inspect memory pressure → store or retrieve information → update working context → respond or chain actions
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-directed function calls page information between bounded working context and persistent external memory under explicit control-flow management.

title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
problem: Manually engineering dense rewards for complex robotic skills is slow and often suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Reward generation need not be restricted to task-specific templates or human-designed reward primitives.
operational_signature: Generate candidates → execute training → summarize component dynamics → mutate the best candidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Component-level reward reflection grounds evolutionary edits in observed policy training dynamics.

title: PromptAgent: Strategic Planning with Language Models Enables Expert-level Prompt Optimization
problem: Expert prompt construction requires costly domain knowledge and inefficient manual exploration.
assumption_broken: Prompt refinement can be planned over future improvements rather than restricted to local paraphrasing.
operational_signature: Collect errors → reflect → expand candidate states → simulate and select paths
load_bearing_mechanism: Monte Carlo tree search directs error-feedback rewrites toward promising future prompt trajectories.

title: Plum: Prompt Learning using Metaheuristic
problem: General interpretable prompt optimization must work without gradients or internal model access.
assumption_broken: Prompt transformations and search strategies can be decoupled rather than fixed to a single heuristic.
operational_signature: Segment candidates → edit or recombine → score outcomes → retain and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Composable prompt neighborhoods let discrete metaheuristics search effectively under limited evaluation budgets.

title: Think-in-Memory: Recalling and Post-thinking Enable LLMs with Long-Term Memory
problem: Repeatedly reasoning over recalled conversation history produces inconsistent answers and costly retrieval.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory can store derived thoughts rather than only raw conversation turns.
operational_signature: Recall relevant thoughts → respond → derive new thoughts → insert, forget, or merge
load_bearing_mechanism: Post-response reasoning persists inductive thoughts and consolidates them for direct later recall.

title: Explore, Select, Derive, and Recall: Augmenting LLM with Human-like Memory for Mobile Task Automation
problem: Repeated mobile automation through fresh LLM reasoning is unreliable, slow, and costly.
assumption_broken: Past executions can be parameterized and reused at the subtask level rather than regenerated or replayed rigidly.
operational_signature: Explore affordances → select subtasks → execute and store → recall and adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: A hierarchical memory of parameterized subtasks reuses execution procedures across changing task arguments.

title: Enhancing Open-Domain Task-Solving Capability of LLMs via Autonomous Tool Integration from GitHub
problem: Fixed toolsets prevent agents from solving evolving specialized open-domain queries.
assumption_broken: Agents can acquire and adapt repositories as tools rather than rely on a predefined tool inventory.
operational_signature: Search resources → configure execution → solve and summarize → retrieve prior environments
load_bearing_mechanism: Bi-level experience learning combines community fixes with reusable execution environments and self-summarized practices.

title: EASYTOOL: Enhancing LLM-based Agents with Concise Tool Instruction
problem: Inconsistent, redundant, and incomplete tool documentation impairs tool selection and argument generation.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation is an optimizable interface rather than a fixed input to the agent.
operational_signature: Extract purpose → standardize parameters → generate examples → verify execution
load_bearing_mechanism: Concise standardized descriptions plus execution-checked usage examples make tool interfaces easier for models to follow.

title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
problem: General computer agents cannot scale manually tailored tools to unfamiliar operating-system applications.
assumption_broken: An agent can acquire application-control tools through its own curriculum instead of requiring a fixed human-built toolkit.
operational_signature: Propose practice tasks → generate tools → execute and critique → retain and retrieve skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-directed practice accumulates executable tools in procedural memory for reuse on unseen requests.

title: PRompt Optimization in Multi-Step Tasks (PROMST): Integrating Human Feedback and Heuristic-based Sampling
problem: Long-horizon agent prompts are difficult to refine because failures are hard to diagnose and candidate rollouts are expensive.
assumption_broken: Feedback diagnosis need not come from the LLM itself, and every generated prompt need not receive a full rollout.
operational_signature: Execute candidates → synthesize rule-based feedback → rewrite prompts → filter with learned scores
load_bearing_mechanism: Human-designed error feedback guides prompt revision while an online score predictor prunes costly low-quality evaluations.

title: Offline Training of Language Model Agents with Functions as Learnable Weights
problem: Manual tool curation and inaccessible model weights limit adaptation of language-model agents.
assumption_broken: Agent functions can serve as trainable parameters while the underlying language model remains frozen.
operational_signature: Evaluate tasks → inspect traces → add, revise, or remove functions → roll back regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive function updates with rollback preserve useful capabilities while optimizing training-set success.

title: Language Agents as Optimizable Graphs
problem: Manually engineered prompting and agent orchestration fragment systems and leave collaboration structures suboptimal.
assumption_broken: Inter-agent connectivity and node prompts can be optimized instead of remaining fixed architecture choices.
operational_signature: Compose operations → sample connections → execute and score → update connection probabilities and prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: REINFORCE optimizes a distribution over acyclic communication graphs while node-level optimization adapts individual prompts.

title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models as Prompt Optimizers: Analogical Analysis with Gradient-based Model Optimizers
problem: LLM-based prompt optimizers lack principled guidance for choosing update information and refinement magnitude.
assumption_broken: Prompt update history and edit distance can be controlled analogously to momentum and learning-rate schedules.
operational_signature: Retrieve relevant history → generate constrained variants → score candidates → retain best and decay edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Relevance-selected optimization trajectories and cosine-decayed edit limits guide progressively finer prompt generation.

title: Agent-Pro: Learning to Evolve via Policy-Level Reflection and Optimization
problem: Action-level self-correction fails to learn strategic policies from delayed feedback in imperfect-information games.
assumption_broken: Reflection can revise underlying beliefs and general behavioral instructions rather than only individual actions.
operational_signature: Play and record beliefs → diagnose failed policies → verify revised instructions → search policy improvements
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-level belief calibration converts failed trajectories into verified behavioral guidelines and world models.

title: LLMs in the Imaginarium: Tool Learning through Simulated Trial and Error
problem: Broad tool access does not ensure accurate tool calls even for tools already seen during training.
assumption_broken: Tool expertise can be acquired by imagined practice with real execution feedback rather than static documentation alone.
operational_signature: Imagine scenarios → execute and refine → distill memories → retrieve demonstrations or fine-tune
load_bearing_mechanism: Short-term trial traces and long-term exploration summaries improve the validity and diversity of tool-learning examples.

title: Self-Improving Customer Review Response Generation Based on LLMs
problem: High volumes of app reviews make accurate app-specific customer responses difficult to produce manually.
assumption_broken: Response-generation prompts can improve automatically through category-specific judge feedback rather than manual prompt engineering.
operational_signature: Generate grounded responses → judge dimensions → diagnose weak cases → rewrite and rescore prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Category-specific LLM critiques of low-scoring responses are distilled into reusable prompt instructions.

title: Prompt Optimization with Human Feedback
problem: Numeric prompt-quality scores are often unavailable or unreliable in direct user interactions.
assumption_broken: Prompt search can use only pairwise preferences rather than scalar scores or labeled validation access.
operational_signature: Generate candidate pool → predict latent utilities → query a preference pair → update the utility model
load_bearing_mechanism: A neural dueling-bandit rule pairs a predicted best prompt with an uncertainty-aware challenger.

title: Buffer of Thoughts: Thought-Augmented Reasoning with Large Language Models
problem: Reasoning methods repeatedly reconstruct expensive solution structures and fail to reuse general insights.
assumption_broken: Reusable high-level reasoning templates can replace fresh reasoning-structure search for each instance.
operational_signature: Distill constraints → retrieve template → instantiate solution → distill and update templates
load_bearing_mechanism: A dynamically managed meta-buffer stores general thought templates for adaptive instantiation on later problems.

title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
problem: Compound AI systems with nondifferentiable components lack general automated optimization methods.
assumption_broken: Feedback can propagate through arbitrary components in natural language without numeric differentiability.
operational_signature: Execute computation graph → critique objective → backpropagate textual feedback → update variables
load_bearing_mechanism: Context-aware textual gradients attribute downstream criticism to upstream variables for targeted revision.

title: Optimizing Instructions and Demonstrations for Multi-Stage Language Model Programs
problem: Multi-stage LM programs need jointly effective module prompts without intermediate labels or gradients.
assumption_broken: Instructions and demonstrations across modules can be jointly optimized using only an end-to-end metric.
operational_signature: Bootstrap successful traces → propose grounded instructions → evaluate combinations → update surrogate and select
load_bearing_mechanism: Grounded instruction proposals and Bayesian credit assignment jointly optimize instructions and bootstrapped demonstrations.

title: EvoAgent: Towards Automatic Multi-Agent Generation via Evolutionary Algorithms
problem: Handcrafted agent roles and skills limit scalable construction of effective multi-agent systems.
assumption_broken: Diverse specialized agents can be generated from existing agent settings without individually designing each role.
operational_signature: Initialize agent → evolve diverse settings → quality-check offspring → aggregate outputs and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-simulated evolutionary operators diversify agent settings and integrate complementary candidate results.

title: Trace is the Next AutoDiff: Generative Optimization with Rich Feedback, Execution Traces, and LLMs
problem: General computational workflows combine heterogeneous parameters and nondifferentiable operations that scalar black-box search optimizes inefficiently.
assumption_broken: Execution traces can provide end-to-end improvement information even when analytic gradients do not exist.
operational_signature: Trace workflow → attach output feedback → extract relevant subgraph → jointly revise parameters
load_bearing_mechanism: OptoPrime uses the minimal execution subgraph to connect rich output feedback to heterogeneous upstream parameters.

title: Symbolic Learning Enables Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Manual optimization of isolated prompts and tools fails to improve whole agent pipelines consistently.
assumption_broken: Prompts, tools, and pipeline structure can be jointly learned as symbolic network weights from task data.
operational_signature: Execute and record trajectory → compute language loss → propagate critiques → update symbolic components and roll back
load_bearing_mechanism: Backward-propagated language gradients coordinate symbolic updates with respect to whole-agent outcomes.

title: Richelieu: Self-Evolving LLM-Based Agents for AI Diplomacy
problem: Diplomatic agents need long-horizon social strategies without relying on domain-specific human demonstrations.
assumption_broken: Useful strategic experience can be generated through self-play and retained rather than supplied by human games.
operational_signature: Generate experience → retrieve analogous outcomes → critique proposed goals → retain new experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Similarity-retrieved self-play memories guide reflection on strategic sub-goals and negotiations.

title: Self-Evolving GPT: A Lifelong Autonomous Experiential Learner
problem: Manually acquiring and selecting task-solving experience cannot scale to an expanding stream of user tasks.
assumption_broken: Task categories and reusable experience can be autonomously discovered and transferred rather than manually predefined.
operational_signature: Categorize requests → transfer related experience → practice and induce rules → store and reuse rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-specific experience induction and cross-task transfer turn self-generated practice into reusable procedural guidance.

title: AutoFlow: Automated Workflow Generation for Large Language Model Agents
problem: Manually designing effective agent workflows requires substantial domain expertise and limits deployment scale.
assumption_broken: Natural-language workflows can be learned from execution scores rather than fixed by human designers.
operational_signature: Generate workflow → execute on examples → score outcomes → update generator and regenerate
load_bearing_mechanism: Execution-derived rewards optimize a workflow generator while keeping the workflow interpreter frozen.

title: GRAD-SUM: Leveraging Gradient Summarization for Optimal Prompt Engineering
problem: Individual-example prompt critiques produce over-specific candidates and costly evaluation.
assumption_broken: Textual gradients should be aggregated across failures before editing rather than applied independently.
operational_signature: Evaluate responses → critique failures → summarize shared feedback → edit and select prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: A gradient summarization module converts example-specific critiques into generalizable prompt edits.

title: Automated Design of Agentic Systems
problem: Hand-designed agent building blocks and workflows constrain the pace and scope of agent development.
assumption_broken: Entire agent designs can be searched as executable programs rather than restricted to predefined prompt or graph spaces.
operational_signature: Inspect discovery archive → program novel design → evaluate and repair → archive scored design
load_bearing_mechanism: An expanding archive preserves stepping stones that a coding meta-agent recombines into novel agent designs.

title: Automated Prompt Engineering for Cost-Effective Code Generation Using Evolutionary Algorithm
problem: Iterative code-repair agents consume many model calls and tokens when starting from inadequate prompts.
assumption_broken: Evolving the initial problem prompt with cheap lexical mutations can replace expensive execution-feedback conversations.
operational_signature: Generate prompt population → execute generated solutions → select by test fitness → mutate and preserve elite
load_bearing_mechanism: Test-fitness-weighted prompt evolution uses inexpensive similar-word substitutions to improve code generation economically.

title: Self-evolving Agents with reflective and memory-augmented abilities
problem: Agents struggle with continuous decisions and information overload as interaction histories grow.
assumption_broken: Historical information should be selectively strengthened, consolidated, and forgotten rather than retained in a simple queue.
operational_signature: Act and receive feedback → reflect on outcomes → strengthen useful memories → retain or forget information
load_bearing_mechanism: MemorySyntax combines reflection with retention-strength thresholds inspired by the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve.

title: Agent Workflow Memory
problem: Web agents fail to reuse common routines across long action trajectories and cannot adapt from past attempts.
assumption_broken: Reusable workflows can be induced from successful trajectories instead of supplied as fixed examples or expert-written routines.
operational_signature: Collect successful trajectories → abstract reusable routines → augment workflow memory → solve subsequent tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Fine-grained workflow induction removes instance-specific values so stored subroutines compose across tasks.

title: Learning from Contrastive Prompts: Automated Optimization and Adaptation
problem: Error-only prompt optimization overfits failures and existing prompts degrade when models or languages change.
assumption_broken: Prompt improvement need not learn only from failures or restart from scratch after a model change.
operational_signature: Generate alternatives → score outcomes → contrast extremes → synthesize and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting high- and low-scoring prompts alongside error feedback guides synthesis without specializing solely to failures.

title: CriSPO: Multi-Aspect Critique-Suggestion-guided Automatic Prompt Optimization for Text Generation
problem: Single-metric feedback inadequately guides prompt optimization for nuanced text generation.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimizers can discover their own critique dimensions and optimize prompt structure rather than only fixed instruction text.
operational_signature: Generate outputs → discover flaws → suggest edits → synthesize and score alternatives
load_bearing_mechanism: A receptive optimizer conditions on historical multi-aspect critiques and actionable suggestions to explore more effective prompts.

title: Gödel Agent: A Self-Referential Agent Framework for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Fixed agent pipelines and meta-learning routines restrict the space of discoverable agent designs.
assumption_broken: The optimizer and its permitted actions need not remain fixed while the agent improves.
operational_signature: Inspect implementation → propose changes → execute and assess → recursively revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Runtime monkey patching lets the agent rewrite both its task policy and its self-improvement logic.

title: AutoDAN-Turbo: A Lifelong Agent for Strategy Self-Exploration to Jailbreak LLMs
problem: Manually specified adversarial strategies limit automated red-team diversity and reuse.
assumption_broken: The strategy repertoire can be discovered and expanded rather than fixed by human designers.
operational_signature: Explore alternatives → evaluate responses → abstract improvements → retrieve and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful response improvements are summarized into a reusable strategy library indexed by prior responses.

title: AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space
problem: Manual agent design and unstructured code search fail to efficiently reuse successful agent components.
assumption_broken: Agent components from separate systems can be standardized and recombined rather than optimized as inseparable designs.
operational_signature: Standardize components → recombine and evolve → predict promise → evaluate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Standardized module interfaces enable evolution and recombination while an in-context surrogate filters costly evaluations.

title: From Exploration to Mastery: Enabling LLMs to Master Tools via Self-Driven Interactions
problem: Ambiguous and inaccurate human-centric tool documentation prevents reliable LLM tool use.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation can evolve from autonomous execution experience rather than remain a fixed human-written interface.
operational_signature: Explore diverse uses → execute trials → analyze discrepancies → rewrite and stop on convergence
load_bearing_mechanism: Tool execution feedback drives iterative documentation rewrites with diversity constraints and adaptive stopping.

title: StraGo: Harnessing Strategic Guidance for Prompt Optimization
problem: Failure-focused prompt rewriting introduces regressions on previously correct examples.
assumption_broken: Prompt optimization should preserve positive experiences and receive actionable strategies rather than only error descriptions.
operational_signature: Analyze successes and failures → formulate strategies → cross revised candidates → evaluate and cache
load_bearing_mechanism: Balanced positive and negative experience analysis generates stepwise strategies whose prompt revisions are crossed over.

title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation
problem: Manual workflow construction and inefficient automated search limit effective agent deployment.
assumption_broken: Workflow topology and prompts can be searched jointly in code rather than fixed before prompt tuning.
operational_signature: Select past design → edit structure → execute repeatedly → propagate experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Tree-structured experience ties code modifications to execution feedback and guides future workflow expansion.

title: Agent-as-a-Judge: Evaluate Agents with Agents
problem: Outcome-only evaluation misses intermediate agent failures while expert manual evaluation is costly.
assumption_broken: Evaluation can itself use agentic investigation rather than a single LLM judgment or final success metric.
operational_signature: Decompose requirements → inspect artifacts and traces → retrieve evidence → judge fulfillment

title: Remember Me, Refine Me: A Dynamic Procedural Memory Framework for Experience-Driven Agent Evolution
problem: Append-only procedural memories accumulate irrelevant or harmful experiences and fail to adapt to changing tasks.
assumption_broken: Stored experience must be adapted and pruned rather than passively accumulated.
operational_signature: Contrast trajectories → distill experiences → adapt retrieval → track utility → prune
load_bearing_mechanism: Fine-grained procedural experiences are selectively added after success and deleted when repeated retrieval has low observed utility.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library
problem: Prompt-only skill-library agents inconsistently generate useful reusable skills and exploit them on later tasks.
assumption_broken: Skill generation can be trained using rewards from subsequent tasks rather than isolated task outcomes.
operational_signature: Chain tasks → generate skills → reuse skills → reward downstream success → update policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Sequential rollouts retain skills across related tasks and assign skill-integrated rewards to generation and successful reuse.

title: Toward Training Superintelligent Software Agents through Self-Play SWE-RL
problem: Software-agent reinforcement learning depends on human-curated issues and tests that limit scalable learning experience.
assumption_broken: Bug-generation curricula and task specifications need not be human-provided or static during training.
operational_signature: Generate challenges → validate consistency → attempt repairs → jointly update both roles
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared policy jointly learns bug injection and repair so the training curriculum evolves with the solver.

title: MemEvolve: Meta-Evolution of Agent Memory Systems
problem: Fixed manually engineered memory architectures constrain how agents learn from experience across task contexts.
assumption_broken: The architecture that encodes, stores, retrieves, and manages experience can itself be evolved rather than held fixed.
operational_signature: Accumulate experience → measure outcomes → diagnose architectures → redesign and select
load_bearing_mechanism: An outer diagnose-and-design loop evolves memory implementations using task performance and resource feedback from inner-loop learning.

title: GenEnv: Difficulty-Aligned Co-Evolution Between LLM Agents and Environment Simulators
problem: Costly real-world interaction and static synthetic datasets fail to adapt training challenges to an agent's evolving weaknesses.
assumption_broken: The environment's task distribution can be learned alongside the agent rather than fixed before training.
operational_signature: Generate tasks → attempt solutions → estimate difficulty → update generator and solver
load_bearing_mechanism: A curriculum reward trains the simulator to generate tasks near a target intermediate agent success rate.

title: RoboPhD: Self-Improving Text-to-SQL Through Autonomous Agent Evolution
problem: Strong Text-to-SQL systems normally require manual prompt engineering and database-analysis expertise.
assumption_broken: Database-analysis code and SQL instructions can be autonomously evolved from a trivial baseline without supplied SQL-specific strategies.
operational_signature: Evaluate agents → rank competitors → combine strengths → edit and retest artifacts
load_bearing_mechanism: ELO-guided cross-pollination combines complementary successful agents into jointly evolved analysis code and generation instructions.

title: Agentic Memory: Learning Unified Long-Term and Short-Term Memory Management for Large Language Model Agents
problem: Separate heuristic memory controllers limit long-horizon agents' coordinated use of persistent knowledge and finite context.
assumption_broken: Long-term and short-term memory decisions can be jointly learned as actions of the agent's own policy.
operational_signature: Observe information → store selectively → manage interference → retrieve and optimize outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Three-stage trajectories and step-wise GRPO propagate delayed task rewards to both storage and context-management decisions.

title: EvoRoute: Experience-Driven Self-Routing LLM Agent Systems
problem: Fixed backbone assignments make multi-step agent systems unnecessarily costly and slow for their achieved accuracy.
assumption_broken: The model assigned to an agent role need not remain fixed across workflow steps.
operational_signature: Retrieve precedents → filter trade-offs → sample model choices → log outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Step-level experience retrieval supports Pareto filtering and Thompson sampling over model quality, cost, and latency.

title: MemRL: Self-Evolving Agents via Runtime Reinforcement Learning on Episodic Memory
problem: Similarity-only memory retrieval cannot distinguish useful strategies from semantically similar distractions during runtime learning.
assumption_broken: Runtime improvement can optimize experience utility in external memory without changing backbone weights.
operational_signature: Recall related experience → rank by utility → execute with context → update memory values
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-phase retrieval combines semantic gating with reward-updated Q-values to favor experiences that actually improve outcomes.

title: Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks
problem: Flat or static skill libraries lack reliable credit assignment, repair, and restructuring for continual embodied learning.
assumption_broken: Executable skills can form a continually optimized compositional graph rather than a flat collection of reusable snippets.
operational_signature: Compose skills → trace execution → localize and repair faults → refactor with rollback
load_bearing_mechanism: Trace-based responsibility propagation enables localized repairs while maturity gating and rollback-validated refactoring protect reliable reusable skills.

title: AgentDevel: Reframing Self-Evolving LLM Agents as Release Engineering
problem: Aggregate-score-driven agent improvement can silently regress previously solved cases and produce unauditable version histories.
assumption_broken: Improvement can be external release engineering with a single canonical agent rather than in-agent reflection or population search.
operational_signature: Record symptoms → execute diagnosis → synthesize candidate → gate regressions and promote
load_bearing_mechanism: Example-level pass-to-fail and fail-to-pass gating rejects regressions that aggregate metrics conceal.

title: TeleMem: Building Long-Term and Multimodal Memory for Agentic AI
problem: Fragmented retrieval and per-turn memory writes cause inconsistent user profiles, hallucinated attributes, and inefficient long-term recall.
assumption_broken: Persistent memories need not remain independent unordered fragments or conform to a fixed profile schema.
operational_signature: Extract grounded narratives → cluster related memories → consolidate states → retrieve dependency closure
load_bearing_mechanism: Coordinated batch consolidation and threaded dependency-aware retrieval preserve coherent memory trajectories rather than isolated facts.

title: Dr. Zero: Self-Evolving Search Agents without Training Data
problem: Data-free search-agent training suffers from homogeneous easy questions and expensive nested proposer-solver sampling.
assumption_broken: Search agents can learn from search-grounded questions they generate themselves rather than curated human QA pairs.
operational_signature: Search and propose → measure solvability → group structural peers → update proposer and solver
load_bearing_mechanism: Hop-grouped advantage estimation makes adaptive difficulty-guided proposer training affordable for multi-turn search.

title: JudgeFlow: Agentic Workflow Optimization via Block Judge
problem: Coarse end-to-end workflow scores do not identify which component needs modification, wasting optimization trials.
assumption_broken: Code-based workflow optimization can use intermediate logic-block responsibility rather than only final scores.
operational_signature: Execute workflows → rank block responsibility → edit weakest block → retain top candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Aggregated failure-trace rankings direct the optimizer toward the consistently most responsible logic block.

title: Beyond Static Tools: Test-Time Tool Evolution for Scientific Reasoning
problem: Sparse static scientific tool libraries cannot anticipate the bespoke computations required by new scientific problems.
assumption_broken: Tools can be generated, verified, and retained during inference rather than prepared as a fixed offline resource.
operational_signature: Decompose needs → retrieve or synthesize → validate and atomize → retain and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: On-demand synthesis followed by atomic refinement converts successful problem-specific computations into reusable library primitives.

title: ExpSeek: Self-Triggered Experience Seeking for Web Agents
problem: Global pre-task experience injection cannot respond to changing observations and confusion during web-agent execution.
assumption_broken: Experience guidance can be sought proactively at uncertain intermediate steps rather than injected once before execution.
operational_signature: Contrast trajectories → distill guidance → detect uncertainty → retrieve and adapt experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Step-type-specific entropy thresholds trigger contextualized experience guidance only when the agent is likely to need it.

title: PACEvolve: Enabling Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution
problem: Evolutionary agents become trapped in polluted local histories and fail to coordinate parallel exploration effectively.
assumption_broken: Search history and restart or crossover schedules need not remain flat or fixed during evolutionary optimization.
operational_signature: Organize ideas → evaluate hypotheses → prune stale context → backtrack or exchange knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical memory and progress-triggered backtracking preserve global exploration while adaptive collaboration shares useful directions.

title: ReCreate: Reasoning and Creating Domain Agents Driven by Experience
problem: Metric-only scaffold search discards causal execution evidence and requires expensive trial-and-error agent creation.
assumption_broken: Scaffold updates can be derived from inspectable execution experience rather than black-box performance scores or fixed component pools.
operational_signature: Inspect experience → diagnose patterns → propose local edits → consolidate domain updates
load_bearing_mechanism: An optimizer agent actively retrieves execution evidence and generalizes instance-specific proposals into reusable domain scaffold changes.

title: AgenticRed: Evolving Agentic Systems for Red-Teaming
problem: Manually specified red-teaming workflows constrain exploration of effective automated safety-testing systems.
assumption_broken: The red-teaming system architecture itself can be evolved rather than only optimizing prompts within a prescribed workflow.
operational_signature: Generate system variants → evaluate candidates → retain generation winner → pass down experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolutionary selection over executable system designs uses archived systems and accumulated successes and failures to guide later generations.

title: Towards Execution-Grounded Automated AI Research
problem: Plausible LLM research ideas often fail when implemented, and scalable execution feedback is difficult to obtain.
assumption_broken: Research ideation can be optimized against actual parallel training experiments rather than plausibility judgments alone.
operational_signature: Propose ideas → implement changes → execute experiments → exploit winners and explore alternatives
load_bearing_mechanism: A parallel automated executor supplies objective feedback for evolutionary ideation that mixes successful variants with new directions.

title: MetaGen: Self-Evolving Roles and Topologies for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning
problem: Fixed role libraries and frozen communication graphs mismatch tasks and cannot adapt to evidence emerging during reasoning.
assumption_broken: Role prompts and collaboration topology can both change during inference without backbone fine-tuning.
operational_signature: Generate roles → instantiate sparse graph → refine from feedback → cache verified specialists
load_bearing_mechanism: Within-instance role and edge edits combine with reward-updated cross-instance selection priors and verified role reuse.

title: PathWise: Planning through World Model for Automated Heuristic Design via Self-Evolving LLMs
problem: Fixed evolutionary operators and stateless heuristic sampling cause myopic search and redundant evaluations.
assumption_broken: Heuristic derivation actions can be semantically planned from search history rather than drawn from fixed operator templates.
operational_signature: Represent derivations → plan transformations → synthesize and evaluate → route reflections and retain descendants
load_bearing_mechanism: An entailment graph preserves derivation rationale while separate policy and synthesis critics adapt subsequent search decisions.

title: Meta Context Engineering via Agentic Skill Evolution
problem: Handcrafted context schemas and optimization workflows bias context learning toward suboptimal representations and update strategies.
assumption_broken: The skill governing context representation and learning can be optimized alongside the resulting context artifacts.
operational_signature: Inspect skill history → synthesize engineering skill → execute context learning → validate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: A meta-agent evolves executable context-engineering skills through deliberative crossover over prior skills and their evaluated outcomes.

title: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers
problem: Performance gains in memory-based self-evolving agents do not establish whether decisions causally depend on accumulated experience.
assumption_broken: The presence and apparent benefit of condensed experience do not imply faithful semantic use of that experience.
operational_signature: Collect experience → perturb its content → rerun decisions → compare causal dependence
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled interventions separately disrupt raw and condensed memories to distinguish content use from superficial prompt effects.

title: TTCS: Test-Time Curriculum Synthesis for Self-Evolving
problem: Difficult and scarce test questions yield unreliable pseudo-labels and unstable online reasoning updates.
assumption_broken: Test-time adaptation need not train exclusively on the original fixed test questions.
operational_signature: Generate variants → estimate consistency → update coupled policies → refresh curriculum
load_bearing_mechanism: A trainable synthesizer targets the solver capability frontier while the solver learns from consensus-labeled original and synthetic questions.

title: Self-Consolidation for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Success-only trajectory replay loses failure lessons and grows beyond practical context limits.
assumption_broken: Historical experience need not remain exclusively as retrieved text.
operational_signature: Contrast outcomes → extract lessons → distill experience → reuse hybrid memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-rich teacher actions are distilled into compact learnable prompt tokens that complement recent textual insights.

title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation
problem: Similarity retrieval over correlated interaction histories returns redundant context and obscures decisive differences.
assumption_broken: Agent memory should not be organized by compressing raw histories before isolating distinctive evidence.
operational_signature: Decouple evidence → aggregate components → revise groups → expand selectively
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-first decoupling creates revisable groups whose complementary contents are expanded only when they reduce reader uncertainty.

title: Live-Evo: Online Evolution of Agentic Memory from Continuous Feedback
problem: Static memory evolution cannot reliably suppress stale experience or adapt guidance under continuous distribution shift.
assumption_broken: How experiences are compiled into guidance can itself evolve rather than remain a fixed summarization procedure.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → compile guidance → contrast outcomes → update usage rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Memory-on versus memory-off feedback jointly reweights experiences and revises meta-guidelines for compiling future guidance.

title: MemSkill: Learning and Evolving Memory Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Fixed handcrafted memory operations cannot adapt extraction and revision behavior to diverse interaction traces.
assumption_broken: The memory operation vocabulary and selection policy can both be learned rather than fixed by designers.
operational_signature: Select routines → construct memory → mine failures → evolve routines
load_bearing_mechanism: A hard-case designer evolves reusable memory skills while an RL controller learns to compose the changing skill bank.

title: CPMobius: Iterative Coach-Player Reasoning for Data-Free Reinforcement Learning
problem: Adversarial task generators can collapse into unlearnable curricula while reasoning training remains dependent on curated data.
assumption_broken: A task proposer can optimize cooperative learning progress instead of merely challenging the solver.
operational_signature: Propose tasks → train solver → measure progress → reinforce proposer
load_bearing_mechanism: Coach rewards multiply instruction-level solver success by post-update accuracy improvement on a fixed validation environment.

title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
problem: Memory abstraction discards useful details while unstructured specificity fragments information and burdens retrieval.
assumption_broken: Memory content and its retrieval index need not share the same representation.
operational_signature: Extract concepts → consolidate details → link cues → navigate adaptively
load_bearing_mechanism: Stable primary abstractions consolidate detailed values while many-to-many cue anchors expose nonlocal retrieval paths.

title: SE-Bench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution with Knowledge Internalization
problem: Prior knowledge and reasoning difficulty confound measurement of whether agents internalize genuinely new knowledge.
assumption_broken: Successful context-assisted learning does not establish durable knowledge acquisition without reference access.
operational_signature: Obfuscate knowledge → collect demonstrations → train without references → test composition
load_bearing_mechanism: Randomized API identifiers isolate novelty while withholding documentation during parameter updates forces knowledge into weights.

title: Group-Evolving Agents: Open-Ended Self-Improvement via Experience Sharing
problem: Isolated evolutionary branches waste complementary discoveries instead of accumulating agent improvements.
assumption_broken: Agents need not evolve as isolated individuals with strictly tree-structured inheritance.
operational_signature: Select diverse performers → pool experiences → reflect and edit → evaluate and archive
load_bearing_mechanism: Sharing evolutionary traces across a selected parent group lets offspring consolidate complementary improvements.

title: UI-Mem: Self-Evolving Experience Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning in Mobile GUI Agents
problem: Sparse long-horizon GUI rewards and repeated cross-task mistakes make online reinforcement learning inefficient.
assumption_broken: Experience can be abstracted into transferable guidance rather than retained only as raw replay trajectories.
operational_signature: Retrieve templates → vary guidance → execute and optimize → abstract and refresh memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Stratifying memory guidance within GRPO groups preserves outcome diversity while transferring reusable experience into the policy.

title: Learning to Continually Learn via Meta-learning Agentic Memory Designs
problem: Fixed handcrafted memory designs limit agents' ability to reuse experience across diverse changing tasks.
assumption_broken: Memory schemas and update and retrieval algorithms can be learned rather than manually fixed.
operational_signature: Sample designs → reflect and implement → evaluate reuse → archive designs and logs
load_bearing_mechanism: An archive-guided coding Meta Agent searches executable memory update and retrieval designs using deployment success feedback.

title: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
problem: Raw trajectory memories are noisy and fail to provide reusable behavioral principles for policy improvement.
assumption_broken: Agent experience need not be reused as raw trajectories or a fixed memory bank.
operational_signature: Collect outcomes → distill hierarchical skills → retrieve and train → diagnose failures and revise skills
load_bearing_mechanism: A hierarchical skill library distilled from successes and failures co-evolves with a skill-conditioned GRPO policy.

title: ImprovEvolve: Basin-Hopping Meets LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
problem: Evolving monolithic mathematical optimizers overloads the model and yields brittle search procedures.
assumption_broken: The evolved program need not directly output the entire solution through an end-to-end optimizer.
operational_signature: Evolve operators → initialize candidates → perturb and improve → validate and retain elites
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-evolved initialization, improvement and perturbation operators run inside a fixed monotonic basin-hopping scaffold.

title: Reinforcing Chain-of-Thought Reasoning with Self-Evolving Rubrics
problem: Outcome-only rewards underspecify reasoning quality while fixed process reward models become stale.
assumption_broken: Reasoning supervision criteria need not be fixed or human annotated during reinforcement learning.
operational_signature: Generate reasoning and criteria → verify satisfaction → filter by outcome correlation → jointly optimize roles
load_bearing_mechanism: Rewarding a shared-policy rubricator for discriminative criteria correlated with correctness continually refreshes process supervision.

title: MetaMem: Evolving Meta-Memory for Knowledge Utilization through Self-Reflective Symbolic Optimization
problem: Fragmented factual memories break logical and temporal relationships and impair downstream reasoning.
assumption_broken: Improving memory use can target transferable utilization instructions instead of only restructuring stored facts.
operational_signature: Sample responses → judge correctness → reflect on evidence use → reconcile and apply memory edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Correctness-guided reflections generate add, delete and modify actions on task-agnostic memory-utilization experiences.

title: Evolutionary System Prompt Learning for Reinforcement Learning in LLMs
problem: Optimizing prompts and model weights independently leaves complementary forms of experience underused.
assumption_broken: System prompts need not remain fixed during reinforcement learning weight updates.
operational_signature: Sample competing contexts → score shared rollouts → update weights and ratings → mutate and recombine instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Reuse of matched on-policy rollouts couples TrueSkill-rated prompt evolution with policy-gradient weight updates.

title: Zombie Agents: Persistent Control of Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Self-Reinforcing Injections
problem: Cross-session memory updates can turn transient indirect prompt injection into persistent unauthorized agent behavior.
assumption_broken: Resetting a session or truncating context does not necessarily remove an injected instruction from a memory-evolving agent.
operational_signature: Expose untrusted content → persist memory → retrieve across sessions → measure unauthorized behavior
load_bearing_mechanism: Architecture-specific renewal and semantic aliasing keep poisoned instructions stored and retrievable across unrelated sessions.

title: Tool-R0: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Tool-Learning from Zero Data
problem: Tool-calling reinforcement learning depends on costly fixed human-curated task datasets.
assumption_broken: Tool-use curricula can be generated and adapted without preexisting task-solution data.
operational_signature: Specify task structure → train challenger → verify and order tasks → train solver and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Separately trained generator and solver co-evolve through difficulty-band rewards and verified synthetic curricula.

title: Structurally Aligned Subtask-Level Memory for Software Engineering Agents
problem: Instance-level memory retrieval confuses globally similar issues with locally different reasoning requirements.
assumption_broken: The whole issue-solving episode need not be the atomic unit of memory storage and retrieval.
operational_signature: Segment functional intent → filter and retrieve → execute subtask → abstract and append experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Hard functional-category filtering followed by local-intent similarity aligns reusable experience with the current reasoning stage.

title: AutoSkill: Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning via Skill Self-Evolution
problem: Stable user preferences and workflows are repeatedly restated rather than consolidated into reusable personalized capabilities.
assumption_broken: Interaction history can become versioned behavioral skills rather than only retrievable factual memory.
operational_signature: Extract durable constraints → compare neighboring skills → add or merge versions → retrieve and inject
load_bearing_mechanism: User-grounded extraction and judge-controlled versioned merging turn recurring requirements into reusable skill artifacts.

title: Self-Play Only Evolves When Self-Synthetic Pipeline Ensures Learnable Information Gain
problem: Self-play pipelines often plateau or collapse because synthetic data does not sustain learnable information gains.
assumption_broken: More self-generated data and reward optimization alone do not ensure sustained self-evolution.
operational_signature: Propose tasks → solve and verify → estimate learnable structure → synchronize roles and expand budgets
load_bearing_mechanism: The paper argues for asymmetric role synchronization, capacity growth and external information acquisition to sustain learnable information.

title: Uni-Skill: Building Self-Evolving Skill Repository for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
problem: Fixed robot skill APIs cannot execute novel manipulation behaviors without manual demonstrations or implementation.
assumption_broken: A robot planner can request and ground new skills rather than compose only a predefined library.
operational_signature: Detect capability gap → describe missing skill → retrieve structured demonstrations → implement and execute
load_bearing_mechanism: A VerbNet-organized demonstration repository grounds newly requested skills with semantic behavior and spatial trajectory references.

title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
problem: General coding agents lack reusable domain expertise and manually authoring skills does not scale.
assumption_broken: Optimization can produce portable skill folders instead of only model-specific monolithic prompts or code.
operational_signature: Inspect failures → propose skill change → build reusable folder → validate and retain frontier
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-driven proposals become executable skill folders that survive only when improving validation-ranked frontier performance.

title: AutoHarness: improving LLM agents by automatically synthesizing a code harness
problem: LLM agents lose tasks by emitting prohibited actions despite understanding task instructions.
assumption_broken: An action-validating harness or full policy need not be manually implemented or executed through repeated LLM reasoning.
operational_signature: Select code hypothesis → execute rollouts → consolidate errors → refine and rescore
load_bearing_mechanism: Thompson-sampled code search uses environment legality feedback to synthesize action filters, verifiers or complete policies.

title: SkillNet: Create, Evaluate, and Connect AI Skills
problem: Fragmented agent experience lacks systematic consolidation, quality control and reuse across tasks.
assumption_broken: Skills can be maintained as evaluated interconnected assets rather than isolated manually curated instructions.
operational_signature: Extract capabilities → filter and evaluate → connect structured packages → retrieve and execute
load_bearing_mechanism: An ontology-linked skill repository combines multi-source extraction with multidimensional quality filtering and on-demand activation.

title: Evolving Medical Imaging Agents via Experience-driven Self-skill Discovery
problem: Static medical tool chains cannot accumulate reliable multi-step routines as imaging tasks and clinical requirements change.
assumption_broken: Tool action spaces can grow from successful interaction traces instead of remaining predefined after deployment.
operational_signature: Retrieve similar cases → execute tools → mine successful sequences → register composites and reinforce reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Frequent verified tool subsequences become composite actions whose use is reinforced by GRPO.

title: SAHOO: Safeguarded Alignment for High-Order Optimization Objectives in Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Iterative output refinement can improve apparent quality while drifting from constraints and undoing earlier gains.
assumption_broken: Improvement cannot be assessed by capability metrics alone without monitoring alignment drift and regression.
operational_signature: Critique and revise → measure drift → check invariants and regression → continue or halt
load_bearing_mechanism: A calibrated multi-signal Goal Drift Index and constraint-prioritized stopping rules gate iterative refinement.

title: RetroAgent: From Solving to Evolving via Retrospective Dual Intrinsic Feedback
problem: Sparse success rewards encourage premature convergence and leave reusable experience inaccessible in policy weights.
assumption_broken: Past trajectories can provide both progress-sensitive intrinsic rewards and explicitly reusable lessons rather than only terminal rewards.
operational_signature: Execute episodes → reflect on progress and lessons → retrieve by relevance and utility → optimize acting and reflection
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual hindsight feedback couples historical-progress rewards with utility-aware lesson retrieval to guide exploration and reuse.

title: MM-Zero: Self-Evolving Multi-Model Vision Language Models From Zero Data
problem: Multimodal self-evolution remains constrained by preexisting image datasets even when textual supervision is synthetic.
assumption_broken: A vision-language training loop can synthesize its own images through code rather than require seed visual data.
operational_signature: Propose visual tasks → render through code → verify and balance difficulty → train roles in sequence
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolving proposer, renderer and solver create a filtered visual curriculum using execution and answer-consistency rewards.

title: AutoAgent: Evolving Cognition and Elastic Memory Orchestration for Adaptive Agents
problem: Static tool and peer descriptions, rigid workflows and redundant histories impede adaptive agent decisions.
assumption_broken: Descriptions mediating action selection can be continuously revised from operational experience rather than treated as fixed prompts.
operational_signature: Assemble contextual memory → choose and execute → compare intentions with outcomes → revise cognition and reuse skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrospective intention-outcome analysis updates structured cognition while elastic memory compresses and organizes reusable experience.

title: MineEvolve: Self-Evolution with Accumulated Knowledge for Long-Horizon Embodied Minecraft Agents
problem: Long prerequisite chains repeatedly fail when execution feedback is not converted into reusable recovery knowledge.
assumption_broken: Failures should induce explicit triggered repairs rather than remain passive trajectory memories or prompt another full replan.
operational_signature: Monitor typed outcomes → induce skills and remedies → validate and retrieve → repair unfinished plans
load_bearing_mechanism: Environment-grounded skills and failure remedies condition local plan repair while preserving completed progress.

title: Your Code Agent Can Grow Alongside You with Structured Memory
problem: Static code agents fail to reuse the developer intent and repair reasoning embedded in repository history.
assumption_broken: Repository history can be reconstructed into evolving procedural guidance rather than treated as a static code snapshot.
operational_signature: Structure historical repairs → retrieve relevant precedents → refine verification → internalize validated solutions
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured historical intent-to-code mappings ground execution-time verification and are extended with human-validated solutions.

title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning
problem: Self-generated reasoning curricula drift in quality and lack explicit planning for multistep problems.
assumption_broken: Task generation, planning, solving, and quality control can co-evolve rather than remain fixed training components.
operational_signature: Generate verified challenges → gate plans and questions → solve and score → jointly update roles
load_bearing_mechanism: Critic-gated curriculum and plans stabilize adversarial Challenger-Solver training on a shared backbone.

title: CLAG: Adaptive Memory Organization via Agent-Driven Clustering for Small Language Model Agents
problem: Global memory evolution and retrieval expose small models to topic interference and distracting context.
assumption_broken: Memory organization can be agent-controlled and locally adaptive instead of a single global retrieval pool.
operational_signature: Route incoming experience → consolidate local neighbors → select relevant clusters → retrieve focused memories
load_bearing_mechanism: Semantic cluster boundaries localize memory rewrites and retrieval to reduce cross-topic corruption and distractors.

title: SEMAG: Self-Evolutionary Multi-Agent Code Generation
problem: Fixed-depth code-generation workflows and manually selected backbones waste resources and become outdated.
assumption_broken: Reasoning depth and backbone choice can adapt to task feedback and newly available models.
operational_signature: Attempt a solution → escalate on stagnation → aggregate repairs → discover and select backbones
load_bearing_mechanism: Trace-triggered hierarchical escalation allocates deeper collaborative debugging only when simpler generation fails.

title: GASP: Guided Asymmetric Self-Play For Coding LLMs
problem: Goal-agnostic self-play can generate hard problems that do not improve relevant downstream capabilities.
assumption_broken: Learnability alone is insufficient guidance; hard real-data goalposts can steer synthetic curricula.
operational_signature: Identify unsolved goalposts → generate learnable simplifications → lift their difficulty → update teacher and student
load_bearing_mechanism: Goalpost-conditioned lemma generation followed by goalpost-blind lifts creates relevant stepping stones at two learnability levels.

title: ARISE: Agent Reasoning with Intrinsic Skill Evolution in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
problem: External skill retrieval and independently updated libraries prevent reasoning rewards from shaping skill management.
assumption_broken: Skill selection and generation can be endogenous policy actions rather than fixed external preprocessing.
operational_signature: Summarize successful traces → manage a tiered library → select skills by policy scores → reinforce useful skill use
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared Manager-Worker policy and skill-conditioned correctness bonus couple library enrichment with reasoning optimization.

title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild
problem: Deployed agents need both immediate behavioral adaptation and slower policy improvement without disrupting service or reusing stale rewards.
assumption_broken: Prompt-level skill evolution and weight optimization can be coordinated across different timescales during deployment.
operational_signature: Distill failures into skills → collect post-adaptation trajectories → filter by skill version → optimize during idle windows
load_bearing_mechanism: Versioned support-query separation coordinates immediate skill injection with opportunistic policy optimization.

title: VeriAgent: A Tool-Integrated Multi-Agent System with Evolving Memory for PPA-Aware RTL Code Generation
problem: RTL generation optimizes correctness without accumulating reusable physical-design optimization experience.
assumption_broken: EDA feedback need not remain transient or optimize correctness alone.
operational_signature: Generate → execute → abstract feedback → update memory → retrieve guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory manager inserts, refines, or discards triggered optimization rules extracted from verification and synthesis trajectories.

title: AgentFactory: A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
problem: Textual experience does not reliably reduce repeated effort on complex procedural tasks.
assumption_broken: Reusable experience can be executable subagents rather than prose reflections.
operational_signature: Decompose → generate executable routines → execute → repair → store and reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful Python subagents are persisted and repaired against subsequent task feedback instead of reconstructing solutions from textual memories.

title: Learning to Self-Evolve
problem: Off-the-shelf prompt editors are not explicitly trained to extract transferable improvements from task feedback.
assumption_broken: The ability to improve contexts is a trainable skill rather than a fixed byproduct of general reasoning.
operational_signature: Evaluate context → summarize errors → propose edit → reward improvement → branch and revisit
load_bearing_mechanism: Single-step reinforcement learning rewards the downstream accuracy change relative to the pre-edit context.

title: Beyond Scalar Rewards: Dense Feedback for LLM Policy Synthesis in Sequential Social Dilemmas
problem: Scalar self-play reward aliases different coordination failures requiring opposite policy corrections.
assumption_broken: Auxiliary social metrics can guide reward maximization without being explicit optimization objectives.
operational_signature: Generate policy → validate → self-play → expose diagnostic metrics → rewrite
load_bearing_mechanism: Dense efficiency, equality, sustainability, and peace feedback disambiguates failure modes during code-policy refinement.

title: Hyperagents
problem: Fixed handcrafted improvement mechanisms constrain agent evolution outside domains where task and modification skills align.
assumption_broken: The procedure generating agent improvements can itself be editable rather than an immutable meta-level controller.
operational_signature: Select ancestor → rewrite task and modifier code → evaluate → archive → branch
load_bearing_mechanism: A unified editable hyperagent can modify both its task-solving code and the meta-agent that proposes future changes.

title: Polaris: A Gödel Agent Framework for Small Language Models through Experience-Abstracted Policy Repair
